questions.question: What is the difference between a vertebrate and an invertebrate?
questions.expected_answer: A vertebrate has a backbone and a skeleton of bones inside its body. An invertebrate has no backbone and no bones inside its body.

questions.question: Name two invertebrates with soft bodies and two invertebrates with a hard outer covering.
questions.expected_answer: Soft bodies: earthworms, slugs, jellyfish or octopuses. Hard outer covering: crabs, mussels, sea snails, beetles, ants, spiders or scorpions.

questions.question: Name the five groups of vertebrates and give one example of each.
questions.expected_answer: Fish, such as the galjoen; amphibians, such as frogs; reptiles, such as snakes, lizards or crocodiles; birds, such as gulls or the blue crane; and mammals, such as dogs, whales or people.
